formal_retrieval_freeze.shortfall_policy: fewer than 12 selected chunks requires a deterministic recorded reason; target-specific compensation is prohibited

protocol_update_steps.action: set protocol version to 1.0 and status to post-pilot formal freeze while formal execution remains not started
complete the 1.0 revision row with evidence-backed pilot IDs, retrieval values, context format, runtime/parser versions, and in-repository BM25 version
replace all four TBD_AFTER_PILOT occurrences with the common frozen values
replace resolvable TBD_IMPLEMENTATION occurrences with tree-sitter 0.26.0, tree-sitter-cpp 0.23.4, in-repository-bm25-okapi-v1, and CPython 3.13.5
resolve grammar provenance without guessing: freeze the distribution version or add separately verified upstream commit evidence
record immutable yaml-cpp run01 limits and separate mechanics-only PASS without treating either as formal effect evidence
verify repository-wide absence of TBD_AFTER_PILOT and TBD_IMPLEMENTATION before target enablement

tbd_inventory.blocker: If an upstream grammar commit remains mandatory, obtain verifiable distribution-to-commit provenance; do not infer it.

steps: verify protocol freeze, common config, target registry, query policy, environment, repository commits, clean worktrees, and frozen source hashes and ranges
validate each existing deterministic rag/query/<target-id>/query.json and query_validation.json without manual additions
apply the identical common retrieval settings to all 17 targets
filter forbidden paths, target overlap, previous LLM output, experiment/report/generated/test content, and duplicates before ranking
run exact-symbol, allowed one-hop, AST usage/call-site, and auxiliary in-repository BM25 stages in the frozen ordering
serialize candidate, selected, context, corpus, query, and manifest artifacts canonically
independently regenerate each target in a separate temporary output and compare all hashes and ordering
publish only byte-identical outputs and keep every target disabled through aggregate audit
deterministic_context_generation.failure_action: preserve mismatch evidence and stop the whole formal batch without target-specific tuning

per_context_validation.requirement: selected_chunk_count <= 12 and every shortfall has a deterministic reason
tier counts do not exceed 4,4,3,1 and common ordering is preserved
zero overlap with frozen half-open ranges; module_files exclude entire target files
zero selected test, benchmark, build, generated, report, log, experiment, prior LLM, README, docs, vendor, third-party, or external content
unique chunk IDs and content SHA-256 values, no equivalent overlap, and recorded reasons for retained declaration-definition pairs
no target source, test answer or expected output, prior generated output, report, or formal result leaks into context
two builds match in query, corpus/index, candidates, selected IDs/order, context bytes, and manifest content hashes
exact-byte hashes and cross-links reverify after publication with no absolute path or timestamp in content hashes

design_generation_allowed_inputs: frozen design instruction and output constraints
separately delimited frozen context.txt pinned by path and SHA-256
code_regeneration_allowed_inputs: single frozen design_document.md from the one-shot design call
fixed scaffold frozen and hashed before code generation
generation_input_isolation.verification: store exact direct-input paths, bytes, and SHA-256 cross-links in plan and request artifacts before enablement

frozen scaffold and code prompt, request, markers, response, and result

referenced evidence, config, source, query, index, or context hash differs
upstream grammar commit remains mandatory but unverified
a TBD marker remains in the formal-freeze protocol
a common setting differs, an override exists, or a manual target query exists
target count is not 17 or target identity, commit, source, tests, or frozen non-RAG setting differs
repository or submodule is dirty or at the wrong commit
context budget, top-k, quota, overlap, forbidden path, duplicate, leakage, determinism, or SHA-256 audit fails
design and code input isolation cannot be proven from stored exact bytes and hashes
non-RAG results or immutable yaml-cpp run01 evidence changed
any target is enabled before aggregate audit or more than one target is enabled
attempt, failure, or result marker already exists for the proposed run ID
source restoration or clean-worktree verification fails
continuation would require retry, repair, overwrite, manual patch, or run-ID reuse
